item.title: Saudi Eksab, IDB Invest and IDC Network Launch Impact Fund With CAF
item.dc:creator: Vicki Jacobson
item.description:
Saudi Eksab, IDB Invest and IDC Network launched the Saudi Eksab, IDC Network Impact Fund with participation from CAF. The fund, managed by Valante Capital, will invest in established businesses across consumer sectors, primarily in Central America and the Caribbean. #PE

item.title: Vinci Compass Agrees to Acquire Controlling Stake in Sanar
item.dc:creator: Vicki Jacobson
item.description:
Vinci Compass agreed to acquire a controlling stake in Sanar, a Brazil-based medical education platform, through its Vinci Capital Partners IV fund. The secondary transaction facilitates exits for existing VC investors, including DNA Capital, Valor Capital, Vox Capital, Península, Green Rock and Igah Ventures. #PE #VC

The post Vinci Compass Agrees to Acquire Controlling Stake in Sanar appeared first on LAVCA.

item.title: Linzor Capital Partners Plans Partial Exit from Farmashop Through IPO
item.dc:creator: Vicki Jacobson
item.description:
Linzor Capital Partners plans to partially exit Farmashop, a Uruguay-based pharmacy chain operating 160 pharmacies nationwide, through a public share offering scheduled for December 2026. Linzor will retain at least a 51% stake in the company. #PE

The post Linzor Capital Partners Plans Partial Exit from Farmashop Through IPO appeared first on LAVCA.
